The page has redirected back to "Manage your subscription" — the subscription section is gone, indicating the cancellation was processed. Let me scroll up to check if a confirmation number is displayed at the top.

The entire page is visible at 0% scroll — the "CURRENT SUBSCRIPTION" section is completely gone. The cancellation was successful, but the portal did not display a confirmation number; it simply redirected back to the main subscription management page. I must not invent one.
